text: The chairman of Iran's Oil Industry Pension Fund, Abdol Hossein Bayat, describes the fund as a subsidiary of Iran's Ministry of Petroleum, while saying it depends on neither the government nor the state budget.
short: The Oil Industry Pension Fund describes itself as a Petroleum Ministry subsidiary.

source.name: ana.ir (Azad News Agency): Iran's Oil Industry Pension Fund Implementing 19 Projects
source.quote: The Oil Industry Pension Fund is a Petroleum Ministry subsidiary, dependent on neither the government nor the state budget
source.note: Report of Bayat's speech at the opening of the 15th Iran Petrochemical Forum, Tehran. Only one publisher found for this statement; a second independent source for the fund's ministry affiliation is noted as missing in the pull request.
